name: Loyal Spark
description: Onchain loyalty protocol on Base. New programs deploy as native B20 Asset programs by default; legacy ERC-20 programs remain supported. Two agent personas: MERCHANT (lsk_, 28 authenticated REST routes + 1 public + 39 MCP tools at /loyalty-mcp) creates programs, registers and activates them when needed, manages rewards, mints tokens, runs P2P trading, gift certificates (LOYAL-XXXXXX), CDP MPC wallets, and POST /earn cashback. RECIPIENT (rwk_, 14 REST routes at /recipient-api + 20 MCP tools at /recipient-loyalty-mcp) holds tokens, redeems rewards, P2P swaps, claims gift certificates, and prepares loyalty token transfers. Pay-per-call via MPP (pathUSD/USDC on Tempo) or x402 v2 (USDC on Base) — both gateways relay merchant + recipient corridors with Coinbase Bazaar discovery metadata.

workflow_hints.rule: Many Loyal Spark actions are multi-step workflows, not single endpoint calls.
workflow_hints.machine_contract: Lifecycle-sensitive REST and MCP responses include workflow.current_step, completed_steps, next_actions, prerequisites, field_catalog, and continuation_context. External agents choose all parameter values.
merchant_program_lifecycle: Choose program name, token symbol, and expiration period
Call POST /programs or create_loyalty_program to get deploy calldata
Extract token_address from B20Created or GET /tx-receipt
If token_standard is erc20, also call activate-program and then program-status active
Create at least one reward before large-scale minting
Only then mint tokens or use earn_points
voucher_flow: Then use voucher via vouchers/use when consumed

authentication.siwe_registration_note: Autonomous agents: POST /siwe-nonce, sign EIP-4361 message including exact phrase 'Register Loyal Spark merchant agent' and Chain ID 8453, then POST to siwe_registration_url. Free key; same limits as dashboard. Doc: https://github.com/aspekt19/unboxed-loyalty-spark/blob/a2a-agents/docs/agents/AUTONOMOUS_AGENT_REGISTRATION.md

escrow.description: P2P token exchange is protected by a smart contract escrow. Atomic swap — both transfers happen in one transaction, or neither does.
flow: 1. Creator approves escrow contract for offer tokens
2. Creator calls createOffer() — tokens locked in escrow
3. Accepter approves escrow contract for request tokens
4. Accepter calls fillOffer() — atomic swap executes
Alternative: Creator calls cancelOffer() — tokens returned

wallets.description: Coinbase CDP MPC wallets on Base — agents get their own server wallet for autonomous onchain operations. No private keys to manage.
wallets.create_endpoint: https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-wallet (POST JSON body per function docs; x-api-key required)

pricing.currency: USDC on Base ($1 = 1 USDC) — applies to subscriptions and pay-per-request only
pricing.transaction_fee_note: The per-plan transaction_fee is the mint protocol fee. It is denominated in the merchant's own loyalty tokens (a separate mint(address,uint256) to the platform fee wallet on the same token contract), NOT in USDC, ETH, or fiat. The token contract does not enforce it on-chain; it is tracked off-chain as a fee obligation and 5+ unpaid obligations older than 60 minutes block further mints with HTTP 402. Confirm each fee with POST /agent-api/mint/confirm or MCP confirm_mint_fee.
pricing.plan_limits_note: Free plan mint quota (1,000 loyalty tokens/mo per owner wallet) is enforced server-side; exceeding it returns HTTP 402. Paid plans remove the mint cap.
pricing.payment: Subscriptions: on-chain USDC transfer to the platform wallet, verified automatically. Mint protocol fees are separate and paid in loyalty tokens (see transaction_fee_note).

access_control.description: Every REST and MCP call is scoped by Postgres row-level security to the owner wallet behind the lsk_/rwk_ key — agents only read and write their own programs, rewards, vouchers, and offers.

x402.description: Fixed-price route payment in USDC on Base. The gateway returns HTTP 402 requirements, verifies and settles before proxying.

mpp.description: Fixed-price route payment with the MPP 402 challenge and credential flow on Tempo.

pay_per_request.boundary: The current gateways do not expose upto, partial capture, void, refund, payout, or split operations.

base_mcp_plugin.description: GET-friendly calldata endpoints designed to be consumed by Base MCP (mcp.base.org) custom plugins. Each response returns a send_calls-compatible batch with the Loyal Spark Builder Code (bc_wdmnog7m, ERC-8021) already appended, so Base Account signs and broadcasts as-is.

why_use.headline: Loyalty-as-a-Service for AI Agents

value_propositions.title: Full Infrastructure Out of the Box
value_propositions.description: Creating an ERC-20 or B20 program is 5% of the work. Loyal Spark provides rewards, vouchers, tiers, analytics, CRM, and marketing automation — via REST, MCP, and the merchant portal.

value_propositions.title: Autonomous Server Wallets
value_propositions.description: Each agent gets a Coinbase MPC wallet on Base. No private keys to manage — sign transactions server-side with enterprise-grade security.

value_propositions.title: Network Effect & Liquidity
value_propositions.description: A standalone token is an island. Tokens on Loyal Spark have real utility through vouchers and P2P escrow swaps (REST for merchants, MCP for holders) — not a DEX order book.

value_propositions.title: Trust & Verification
value_propositions.description: A random agent token has zero trust. Tokens issued through a verified protocol with audit history carry built-in credibility.

value_propositions.title: Ready-Made Audience
value_propositions.description: Agents creating solo tokens must find holders themselves. Through Loyal Spark, agents access existing merchant customer bases instantly.

value_propositions.title: Humans and Agents, Same Protocol
value_propositions.description: Merchants run programs in the web portal; AI agents run the same loop via REST and MCP (lsk_/rwk_) with fee-first mint calldata and prepaid USDC rails (subscriptions, x402, MPP).

value_propositions.title: Composability via Single API
value_propositions.description: Create program → set up tiers → launch referrals → automate minting → track analytics. All through one REST API or MCP Server.

value_propositions.title: Pay-as-you-go Pricing
value_propositions.description: Start free with 200 API calls/month and a 1,000-token monthly mint cap. Scale to Pro ($49/mo) or Enterprise ($129/mo) with lower mint fees and higher limits, or pay per call via MPP / x402 with no subscription. Subscriptions and per-call payments are in USDC on Base; the mint protocol fee is separate and paid in your own loyalty tokens.

why_use.analogy: Think Shopify vs. coding your own store. You could deploy a token yourself, but why build rewards infrastructure from scratch when a protocol exists?

steps: 1. Go to https://loyalspark.online/merchant and sign in (email, phone, Google, or wallet via Privy)
2. Open 'AI Agents' tab → Register an agent → Get API key (lsk_...)
4. Use the API key in x-api-key header for REST or MCP calls
5. Create a server wallet: POST https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-wallet (see Edge Function docs)
6. Start minting tokens, creating rewards, and managing programs!
